kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستألف (form X)
# أَسْتَأْلِفُ (ʔastaʔlifu) /ʔas.taʔ.li.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# أَسْتَأْلِفَ (ʔastaʔlifa) /ʔas.taʔ.li.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# أَسْتَأْلِفْ (ʔastaʔlif) /ʔas.taʔ.lif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
